fullBaseGeometryProof.scope: Independent native base-mesh exact comparison; linked evidence, not re-proven from exported skin

method.trianglesPerMesh: deterministic evenly spaced; 1024 priority shoulder/cuff/axilla/elbow meshes; 128 others
method.collapse: numeric near-zero: area ratio < 0.0001; unchanged M2 severe engineering alarm: area ratio < 0.05 with >3 OR >1% eligible sampled triangles per mesh; not a medical threshold
method.stretch: edge ratio > 2 (100% elongation), gross numerical deformation screen, not a biological threshold
method.limitations: Finite surface samples cannot prove all triangles; interpenetration, anatomical attachments, strain tolerance and acceptable motion remain INCONCLUSIVE. Native clips are authored diagnostic poses, not approved exercise motions. No left/right biological symmetry assumption.
